question: How likely is the 'solar plant west davidport' (matching the name regardless of case) to be down when we need it? Give me its system unavailability score, just the number, to four decimal points.
pred_sql:
SELECT ROUND((om.mttrh / (om.mtbfh + om.mttrh))::numeric, 4)
FROM plants p
JOIN plant_record pr ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
JOIN operational_metrics om ON pr.snapkey = om.snapops
WHERE p.sitelabel ILIKE 'solar plant west davidport'
